processes:task-ao-operate-transform-ca98.plain_language_description: With the completions verified, the processing custodian makes the evaluation itself: each completed programme's effectiveness is weighed against the gaps it was committed to close, and the evaluation is set down in the form the activity defines. processes:task-ao-operate-verify-4c2ckz.plain_language_description: Before any programme is judged, the verification custodian checks the completions against what evaluation requires - that the record covers the whole programme and its targeted gaps. worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds one programme's completions missing a whole cohort and logs the gap before the evaluation judges it.
